notes: Several hits are other Plymouths or other towns: #5 North Bridgewater, Massachusetts; #10/#13 Ivybridge; #11 New Plymouth, New Zealand; #12 New York; #14 Allentown; #17 Plymouth Meeting, Pennsylvania. Undated paintings skipped: #1 Hannan, #3 Reynell, #7 Johns and #18 Payne (their ‘dates’ are birth years or accession numbers). #6 (Dupré lithograph of the port, 1836) is an alternative for P3. #2 is small (1200 px wide). P6 is overcast and the city is distant.
